label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — User input from request.queryString flows to param, then to bar via doSomething. Although doSomething replaces the last character of param with 'Z' if length > 1, the remaining prefix of the string (indices 0 to len-2) remains unchanged and attacker-controlled. This tainted data is placed into the obj array and printed to the HTTP response body via printf, allowing XSS payloads (excluding the last char) to execute. Structural FP not applicable as resolved sink value (obj[0]) depends on user input.

evidence.note: Parsing: param extracted from queryString, preserving user input
Flow: bar assigned result of doSomething(request, param)
Sanitization: doSomething replaces only the last character of param with 'Z'; prefix remains user-controlled
Sink: obj array created with bar and printed to response.getWriter().printf
